description: This file defines the FalSmartTurnAnalyzer class, a subclass of HttpSmartTurnAnalyzer, which integrates with Fal.ai's hosted smart-turn API for end-of-turn detection in conversations. It handles API authentication, customizes API endpoints, and issues deprecation warnings regarding its future removal.
